title: NRMCA Staff Attends ACI Fall 2026 Convention, Files Updates on Ready Mix-Related Developments
description: Committee-by-committee summary of the ACI Fall 2026 Convention (Atlanta, Oct 10–14): ACI 332 residential code tentatively for Nov 2026; ACI 301 revision expected summer 2027; ACI 323 next-edition work incl. precast; ACI 327 RCC pavement spec to TAC (expected 2027); ACI 201 PLC durability report; ACI 551 task group on PLC in tilt-up; ACI 211 heavyweight and limestone-filler proportioning drafts; ACI 318 thermal-control and sulfate proposals; ORNL ACCENT initiative.
evidenceNote: Full article text read 2026-11-09. Secondary industry summary of committee status; schedules are tentative and not adopted documents. Exact issue date not shown on page.

title: ACI CODE-323-24 Low-Carbon Concrete—Code Requirements and Commentary (preview)
description: First edition of ACI's low-carbon concrete code: GWP limits via a weighted carbon-budget approach for cast-in-place concrete with f'c >2500 to ≤8000 psi; precast, shotcrete, pavers and masonry units excluded.
evidenceNote: Official preview PDF retrieved and inspected 2026-11-09 (first printing Nov 2024, errata as of Jan 2, 2025). Full code not purchased. NRMCA Fall 2026 report (same pass) indicates a next edition is in development.
edition: First edition; next edition in development per ACI 323 committee activity reported Oct 2026.

title: EN 197-6:2023 Cement — Part 6: Cement with recycled building materials (SIST adoption preview)
description: Defines recycled concrete fines (RCF, notation F) as a main cement constituent: CEM II/A-F (6–20%) and CEM II/B-F (21–35%) plus RCF in CEM II/C-M and CEM VI; RCF limits on TOC (≤0.8%), SO3 (≤2.0%) and methylene-blue clay.
evidenceNote: Free sample PDF of SIST EN 197-6:2023 inspected 2026-11-09 (scope, RCF requirements, composition table). Full standard not purchased; national application rules differ (e.g., NEN 8005/CUR 48 in NL).
edition: Part 6 published by CEN June 2023; complements EN 197-1:2011 and EN 197-5:2021.

title: Cementnormen (EN 197-1, EN 197-5, EN 197-6 overview; Dutch)
description: Dutch overview of the three EN 197 common-cement parts (~40 cements), the new CEM II/C-M, CEM VI and RCF cements, and the Dutch rule that most non-traditional types need CROW-CUR Recommendation 48 suitability evidence under NEN 8005 before use outside X0.
evidenceNote: Page read 2026-11-09 (Dutch). National-practice explainer, not the normative standard.

title: Standardization of new cements and concrete additions, of recycled concrete, and of performance-based concrete
description: Swiss standards trail: SIA 162/4 (1994) → SIA 2030 recycled concrete (2010, rev. 2021); SIA 2049 new cements (2014) → SIA 215/1 (2025); SIA 215/2 new additions; SN EN 206 National Annex ND (Feb 2025) for ECPC performance-based design.
evidenceNote: Crossref/OpenAlex metadata and abstract inspected 2026-11-09; full text not reviewed.

title: Blended Cement Concrete Database (dataset)
description: Curated literature-derived dataset of 8,979 blended cement concrete records from 260 publications (mix proportions incl. slag, fly ash, silica fume, limestone, calcined clay) for ML/materials-informatics use.

title: Heat of hydration of portland cement pastes (NBS RP684)

identifiers.journal: Bureau of Standards Journal of Research 12:645

description: Foundational determination of heats of hydration of C3S, C2S, C3A and C4AF and of cement pastes over time; basis for later low-heat (Type IV) and compound-based heat estimates.
evidenceNote: NIST PDF retrieved and first pages inspected 2026-11-09. Historic 1934 methods/values; compare with modern calorimetry standards before reuse.
rights: Public domain (US Government work, per OpenAlex)

title: Relationship of the garnet-hydrogarnet series to the sulfate resistance of portland cements (NBS RP1411)
description: Shows that C3AH6 converts to ettringite in sodium sulfate, while Fe/Si-substituted hydrogarnets are sulfate-stable — early mechanistic basis for limiting C3A in sulfate-resisting cements.
evidenceNote: NIST PDF retrieved and abstract page inspected 2026-11-09. Historic lab chemistry; not a specification.
rights: Public domain (US Government work, per OpenAlex)

title: Modification of the Bogue calculation

title: The Rise of Portland Cements
